symptom: `mxcli syntax grant` (also revoke, refresh) answers 'Unknown topic: grant' although grant is a listed keyword of security.entity-access; `mxcli syntax integration message-definition` prints 'No topic "integration.message-definition"' and recovers only through the fallback
cause: syntax.Lookup resolved only against topic PATHS (left-anchored, then any segment); the Keywords every topic carries were never consulted, and a statement verb is nobody's path segment. A leading category word in front of a top-level topic made the left-anchored path miss
insight: Third round of the same lookup gap (#955 segments, #1025 spellings, #1389 verbs): each fix widened what Lookup matches against rather than adding aliases, because the registry already carries the data (paths, then keywords) and an alias table drifts from it. Keyword match is whole-word and runs last so it cannot shadow a path or segment hit; the qualifier rule declines when the head has its own segment match for the word (`workflow microflow` keeps workflow.call-microflow) — the guard's control is that removing it makes that case resolve to the top-level microflow page. Multi-topic answers print an index, not pages, so assert on topic paths, not syntax text
